name: Auth: DEMO_MODE phone allowlist
description: Comma-separated phone digits (no '+', e.g. '79990000000,79990000001') allowed to receive the fixed DEMO_MODE code (e.g. for Apple App Review demo sign-in). Every other number always gets a real CSPRNG code, even with DEMO_MODE=true — this is what keeps one env var on a live box from being 'log in as anyone' (review1 §2).
